j1.what_the_patch_does: Changes SQLiteRunStore.replay() from invoking application replay on serialized data to returning self.load(run_id) directly.
j1.reading_applied: Direct reading: storage replay must not be deserialization; it must recompute output from recorded port responses.
j1.rationale: The new replay implementation is exactly a storage load/deserialization path, replacing the prior application-level replay. It therefore no longer recomputes output from recorded port responses.

j2.what_the_patch_does: Changes SQLiteRunStore.replay() from invoking application replay on stored artifact bytes to returning the stored RunArtifact directly via load(). It also changes observation ordering.
j2.reading_applied: Direct reading: replay must recompute output from recorded port responses, rather than merely deserialize stored output.
j2.rationale: The patch makes storage replay a direct load/deserialization path, eliminating the application-level recomputation that the rule explicitly requires.
